commits.patch:
diff --git a/src/knownhost.c b/src/knownhost.c
index 2bd41de..11290d4 100644
--- a/src/knownhost.c
+++ b/src/knownhost.c
@@ -868,7 +868,7 @@ static int knownhost_line_legacy(LIBSSH2_KNOWNHOSTS *hosts,
             char hostbuf[256];
 
             /* make sure we do not overflow the buffer */
-            if(namelen >= sizeof(hostbuf) - 1)
+            if(namelen > 255)
                 return ssh2_err(hosts->session,
                                 LIBSSH2_ERROR_METHOD_NOT_SUPPORTED,
                                 "Failed to parse known_hosts line "

coupling: The IPv6 known-hosts commit permits the full 255-byte host field while retaining a 256-byte temporary buffer. The later tidy-up reduces that buffer to 255 bytes. Its original size-derived guard would reject the new boundary, but the earlier commit changed the guard to an independent 255-byte limit. A 255-byte bracketed hostname-and-port entry therefore passes validation and writes its terminator one byte past the buffer. Each edit in isolation is memory safe; review and repair must keep the accepted field length and buffer capacity consistent across both commits.
